title: Only 3% Of Eligible People Donate Blood
hook: Only 3% donate blood while the donor pool keeps shrinking.
closing: A stable blood supply depends on more eligible people becoming regular donors.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood, leaving the supply dependent on a tiny volunteer pool.
Blood donor volume fell 40%, so fewer people are replacing the donors hospitals already rely on.
